text:
anu_engineer: Hi @leo_finance - while on a client trip in Berlin my personal card was charged for an Uber ride with a huge surge: €95.60 (converted on card to $102.47). Corporate card declined due to foreign-transaction block. Can this be reimbursed? Receipt attached: https://files.redwood.example/receipts/1838002468-uber-eur95.jpg

leo_finance: Thanks Anu. Two quick asks: 1) need an itemized receipt showing distance/time and the surge line item, 2) manager approval for rideshare claims > $75. Also we need either the exchange rate or a bank statement snippet showing the $102.47 charge.

sam_travelops: Travel ops note: client call in Berlin on 2026-08-18 required Anu to travel from Tegel to client site at odd hours. We can confirm trip was business-required.

anu_engineer: Uploaded screenshots: itemized ride (fare breakdown) here: https://files.redwood.example/receipts/1838002468-uber-itemized.png and bank charge: https://files.redwood.example/itineraries/1838002468-bank-10247.png

dina_mgr: Confirming I asked Anu to be on-site early that day and the ride was necessary. Approving reimbursement. Approving for reimbursement to bank. :white_check_mark:

leo_finance: Thanks Dina. Anu - please submit in Ramp with Expense type = Ground Transport -> Rideshare, tag project-berlin-kairos, attach the two screenshots, and select reimbursement to bank (we can't reimburse personal card charges back to the card for foreign cc conversions). We'll code GL 6420. If you want faster than payroll, reply with "ACH" + last4 of account.

anu_engineer: Submitted RMP-24177 with tags project-berlin-kairos. I put ACH + last4 1199 in the notes.

ramp-bot: Expense RMP-24177 created and routed to Finance. Processing note: Foreign-currency reimbursements will use the amount posted on the bank statement.

leo_finance: We validated docs and manager sign-off. We'll process as ACH on next vendor payout date. Closing thread unless there are discrepancies. :thumbsup:
